label: WhatsApp Bridge (Baileys)
description: WhatsApp bridge (Baileys over WhatsApp Web) that every other WhatsApp node talks to through its `bridge` output. Pair a phone by QR code on first start; the session is kept on disk, so later starts reuse it.

outputs.name: bridge
outputs.description: The bridge's handle. Wire it into the `bridge` input of every other WhatsApp node.
